keySentence: Fogg bet he could circle the globe in 80 days.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Fogg left London that same night. His servant Passepartout went with him. They had 80 days exactly. Fogg bet he could circle the globe in 80 days.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Fogg wasted no time and departed London that very evening. His newly hired servant, Passepartout, was shocked but loyal. Fogg carried a bag with exactly the right amount of money and a precise schedule. Every train, ship, and carriage was planned down to the minute. Fogg bet he could circle the globe in 80 days. The race around the world had officially begun!
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: True to his word, Fogg departed from London that very evening without any hesitation. His servant Passepartout, who had been hired only that morning expecting a quiet life, was stunned. Fogg traveled light, carrying just one carpet bag and a large sum of money in banknotes. He had prepared a meticulous timetable that accounted for every connection and possible delay. Fogg bet he could circle the globe in 80 days. However, Passepartout quickly realized that this journey would test them in ways they could not predict. Because every minute counted, there was absolutely no room for error or unexpected events. As the train pulled out of the station, both master and servant felt the weight of the enormous challenge ahead.
